node: Transformers, dry-type transformers, magnetics, power conditioning, and medium-voltage distribution equipment
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around transformer-adjacent power distribution and magnetics. The two-lane funnel keeps Eaton as a high-attention reference leader, while the underfollowed lane highlights Powell Industries and Bel Fuse as more focused public-market mappings, plus Pioneer Power Solutions as a micro-cap speculative exception. The strongest direct evidence is for medium-voltage switchgear, dry-type transformers, magnetics, and facility/grid power distribution equipment. Transformer manufacturing pure plays remain scarce in US-listed equities, so several candidates are adjacent to the chokepoint rather than pure transformer manufacturers. Layer 1B expansion found one high-attention reference leader and three underfollowed or lower-attention US-listed candidates tied to electrical distribution bottlenecks. The cleanest node fits are Eaton as the broad reference anchor and Powell Industries as a mid-cap medium-voltage switchgear / packaged power-distribution name. Bel Fuse adds a smaller electronic magnetics and power-conversion component lane, while Preformed Line Products is an adjacent grid-transmission hardware candidate rather than a transformer manufacturer. Key verification work should focus on backlog durability, data-center and utility exposure, product-level capacity constraints, customer qualification stickiness, and whether transformer/switchgear bottlenecks translate into margin expansion rather than only revenue growth.
